basis: Logical expectations were fixed in DESIGN-v1/SEMANTIC-FIXTURES-v1 before implementation. These literal masks encode the agreed G=1,C=2,K=4,U=8 MODEL protocol; they are not learned kernel values or actual admission flags.
interpretation: A completed C event and K stores remain historical events after later failure or a hypothetical writer; no mask asserts current memory contents. Tag-only K does not complete the value pair. No actual seed bytes, changed positions, ownership or no-writer guarantee is represented.
